reviews.text:
I live in a hard water area and I wash my hands way too often than I should. so my hands and wrists are very dry and they get red, flaky and itchy sometimes. I used to dislike putting lotion on my hands because I hated having sticky and oily hands and would only apply when the skin around my hands and wrists started to peel and got painful. but I really like this set of hand lotions! I’ve tried all the lotions and finished some (they have the same texture but different scents). they’re all moisturising and absorbs well into the skin without feeling tacky. 

here’s my description of the scents: 
1. lotus bloom (light pink tube) - this tube is my fav! the scent is very light and floral. it reminds me of the scent of lily of the valley flowers 
2. white lily (blue tube) - clean soap scent. I couldn’t stop smelling my hands after application. scent is similar to replica’s lazy Sunday morning 
3. lavender floral (purple tube) - did not expect to like this because I never really liked the scent of lavender. but the lavender scent in this lotion is quite soft and rounded so I quite like it
4. Rosa canina (yellow tube) - the rose scent is kinda faint here. the lotion smells more like incense than rose imo 
5. peony blossom (dark pink tube) - the sweet floral scent is a bit too strong. I wish I could swap this out for another tube of lotus bloom, white lily or lavender floral

I plan to repurchase mediflower’s other series of hand lotion in the future
reviews.zh:
我住喺硬水地區，我洗手次數多過應該嘅次數。所以我嘅手同手腕好乾，會紅、脫皮，有時仲好痕。我以前唔鍾意喺手上搽護手霜，因為唔鍾意雙手又黏又油，只會等到手同手腕周圍嘅皮膚開始脫皮、痛嗰陣先搽。但係我真係好鍾意呢套護手霜！我試過所有款式，亦用完咗幾支（佢哋質地一樣，但香味唔同）。佢哋都好保濕，吸收入皮膚好快，唔會覺得黏。

我嘅香味描述：
1. 蓮花花蕾（淺粉色管）——呢支係我最愛！香味好輕、好花香，令我諗起鈴蘭花
2. 白百合（藍色管）——清潔嘅肥皂味。塗完之後我忍唔住一直聞手。香味似 Replica 嘅 Lazy Sunday Morning
3. 薰衣草花香（紫色管）——我本來冇諗過會鍾意，因為我從來唔係好鍾意薰衣草嘅味道。但係呢款嘅薰衣草香味好柔和、圓潤，我幾鍾意
4. Rosa canina（黃色管）——玫瑰香味比較淡，我覺得呢款聞落更似薰香多過玫瑰
5. 牡丹花（深粉色管）——甜花香有啲太濃。我希望可以換咗佢，換返多一支蓮花花蕾、白百合或者薰衣草花香

我將來打算再買 mediflower 嘅其他系列護手霜。
